meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 回溯历史对话,找到之前怎么解决的
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 记得之前聊过的需求和方案
copy.tagline_en: Search past conversations to recall how you solved it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with AI over many sessions and need it to remember earlier context.

howto.what: 安装后,当你询问过往会话时,它会先搜索跨会话记忆库,列出一份带编号的匹配记录清单;再展示某条记录周围的时间线上下文;最后只调取你选中的记录全文。
howto.when: 当你想查之前会话里做过的事时触发,比如问“这个之前解决过吗”“上次某某是怎么做的”,或要找回以前的工作记录。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么排查登录报错的?
say.note: 它会搜索记忆并展示相关记录上下文。

say.text: 之前是不是已经解决过认证超时的问题?
say.note: Claude 会先列出匹配记录,不直接拉全文。

say.text: 上周在这个项目里改过哪些东西?
say.note: 按日期过滤后返回当时的工作记录。

howto.what_en: When asked about earlier sessions, it searches the cross-session memory database, shows a compact list of matching records with IDs, adds a timeline around a chosen record, then fetches full details only for the records you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or want work from earlier sessions.

say_en.text: How did we debug the login error last time?
say_en.note: Searches memory and shows relevant context.

say_en.text: Did we already fix the auth timeout issue?
say_en.note: Lists matching records first rather than full text.

say_en.text: What did we change in this project last week?
say_en.note: Filters by date and returns past work records.
